description: This file contains utility functions for handling sparse matrices, including conversions between formats, loading datasets, and generating tensors for performance testing of sparse matrix operations in PyTorch, specifically for DLMC datasets.

methods.name: to_coo_scipy
methods.description: Converts a PyTorch sparse tensor to a SciPy COO sparse matrix.

methods.name: sparse_grad_output
methods.description: Computes a gradient output for sparse matrix multiplication, returning a sparse or dense tensor.

methods.name: read_matrix_params
methods.description: Reads matrix dimensions and number of non-zero elements from a file.

methods.name: csr_to_coo
methods.description: Converts CSR format indices to COO format tensor.

methods.name: load_sparse_matrix
methods.description: Loads a sparse matrix from a file and returns a PyTorch sparse tensor.

methods.name: gen_vector
methods.description: Generates a dense vector tensor with random values.

methods.name: gen_matrix
methods.description: Generates a dense matrix tensor with random values.

methods.name: load_spmv_dataset
methods.description: Loads a sparse matrix-vector multiplication dataset for performance testing.

methods.name: load_spmm_dataset
methods.description: Loads a sparse matrix-matrix multiplication dataset for performance testing.

methods.name: load_dlmc_dataset
methods.description: Loads a DLMC dataset for various sparse/dense tensor operations, supporting backward testing.
